question: What claim about the source of transmission is at stake in stating that the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is posited.
It was told by an earth-mover.
The address is to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is presented as transmitted by an earth-mover.
plain_english: O beloved one, the teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover.
